{{Quote|Hetton wants us to strike during the Armistice Celebrations. It will draw more attention if we act on the anniversary of the Ruusan Reformations.|[[Paak]]|<ref name="Rule of Two" />}}
The '''Armistice Celebrations''' were a holiday that celebrated the anniversary of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]]. The celebrations would be held [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the meeting of the [[Anti-Republic Liberation Front]] members prior to the [[kidnap attempt on Serenno]] in [[990 BBY]] according to the [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Kelad'den]].<ref name="Rule of Two" />

They were held across multiple [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] worlds a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] after the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]], in 990 BBY, to mark the end of the [[New Sith Wars]].
